```cmd
for /f "tokens=1-4 delims=/ " %%a in ('date /t') do @set d=%%a-%%b-%%c
for /f "tokens=1-2 delims=:." %%x in ('time /t') do @set t=%%x:%%y

```

That will print something like `2026-11-14 13:45:02`. If you’re running a script and need the current time programmatically, you can use PowerShell:

```powershell
Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
```
